nodes.label: Unit of Synthesis (outcome × timepoint × comparison)
nodes.rationale: Never per study and never 'overall'. Timepoint bands are declared in the protocol before synthesis so they cannot be invented per outcome to make results line up.

nodes.label: Effect-Direction Tabulation
nodes.rationale: Vote counting done properly: direction plus magnitude plus precision plus weight-proxy plus risk of bias, never a bare count of positive studies. A p-value alone never yields a direction, and a study without an interval is 'unreported', not evidence of no effect.

nodes.label: No Pooled Estimates (hard constraint)
nodes.rationale: Where a pooled estimate or I2 appears it is extracted from a published meta-analysis and attributed to it, never produced here. A forest plot may be drawn without a diamond, because a diamond asserts a pooled estimate this pipeline did not compute.

nodes.label: Three Kinds of Heterogeneity
nodes.rationale: Clinical, methodological and statistical must be named separately. I2 is not an absolute measure and depends on study precision; Cochrane's bands overlap on purpose and are never thresholds. Prediction intervals are preferred to pooled CIs for what the evidence implies in a new setting.

nodes.label: Conflict Taxonomy C1-C9
nodes.rationale: Worked in order, stopping at the first cause the data support, with C9 (chance/imprecision) checked first so noise is not given a manufactured explanation. An unexplained conflict is a legitimate reportable finding that feeds GRADE inconsistency; a conflict is not a defect in the report, an unexplained-but-unstated one is.

nodes.label: Publication-Bias Signals Without Meta-Analysis
nodes.rationale: Funnel plots and Egger tests need ~10 studies and a pooled analysis, neither available here, so registry-versus-publication, outcome switching, small-study ordering and funding asymmetry substitute. When none can be assessed, write 'publication bias could not be assessed', not 'no evidence of publication bias'.

nodes.label: The Hard Wall (evidence vs hypotheses)
nodes.rationale: Two sections, never mixed, never adjacent in a paragraph, never in one sentence, with disjoint permitted verb forms. Every hypothesis states what would test it — a hypothesis with no test is speculation and is dropped — and may never later be cited as a finding. Gaps are observations and sit on the evidence side; explanations for gaps sit on the hypothesis side.

nodes.label: Provisional Synthesis Triggers
nodes.rationale: PROVISIONAL appears in the title block, not only a footnote, and each affected synthesis unit states the shortfall locally at the point of the claim. The direction of possible bias is stated where it can be reasoned about and stated as unknown where it cannot. A provisional synthesis is still delivered — never silently completed, never withheld.
